# Docs Please

> Documentation for Docs Please

## Documentation Sets

- [Docs Please](https://docs-please.pages.dev/llms-full.txt): Documentation for Docs Please

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://docs-please.pages.dev/docs/getting-started/introduction): Learn about docs-please and how it works
- [Installation](https://docs-please.pages.dev/docs/getting-started/installation): How to install and set up docs-please
- [Configuration](https://docs-please.pages.dev/docs/getting-started/configuration): Configure your documentation site
- [Writing Content](https://docs-please.pages.dev/docs/getting-started/writing-content): How to write and organize documentation content
- [Edition](https://docs-please.pages.dev/docs/concepts/edition): Learn how to write your documentation.
- [Configuration](https://docs-please.pages.dev/docs/concepts/configuration): Customize your Docus documentation from the Nuxt application configuration file. 
- [LLMs Integration](https://docs-please.pages.dev/docs/concepts/llms): Docus generate AI-ready content files using Nuxt LLMs module
- [Nuxt](https://docs-please.pages.dev/docs/concepts/nuxt): Build interactive and reusable elements with Nuxt components
- [Markdown Syntax](https://docs-please.pages.dev/docs/essentials/markdown-syntax): Text, title, and styling in standard markdown.
- [Code Blocks](https://docs-please.pages.dev/docs/essentials/code-blocks): Display inline code and code blocks in your documentation.
- [Markdown Components](https://docs-please.pages.dev/docs/essentials/components): Use Markdown components to help you structure your content, with the help of shadcn-vue.
- [Images and Embeds](https://docs-please.pages.dev/docs/essentials/images-embeds): Add image, video, and other HTML elements
- [Components Overview](https://docs-please.pages.dev/docs/components/overview): Overview of available components in the documentation layer
- [CodeCollapsibleWrapper](https://docs-please.pages.dev/docs/components/code-collapsible): Collapsible wrapper for long code blocks
- [CopyButton](https://docs-please.pages.dev/docs/components/copy-button): Copy to clipboard button component
- [ButtonA](https://docs-please.pages.dev/docs/components/button-a): Button-styled navigation links
- [Prose](https://docs-please.pages.dev/docs/components/prose): Typography components for markdown content rendering
- [Button](https://docs-please.pages.dev/docs/components/button): Button component with multiple variants and sizes
- [Separator](https://docs-please.pages.dev/docs/components/separator): A visual divider between content sections
- [Callout](https://docs-please.pages.dev/docs/components/callout): Display contextual alerts, notifications, and informational messages
- [Steps](https://docs-please.pages.dev/docs/components/steps): Create numbered step-by-step guides and tutorials
- [Tabs](https://docs-please.pages.dev/docs/components/tabs): Tabbed content sections for organizing related content
- [CodeTabs](https://docs-please.pages.dev/docs/components/code-tabs): Package manager code switcher with automatic command conversion
- [ComponentPreview](https://docs-please.pages.dev/docs/components/component-preview): Display component demos with live preview and source code
- [LinkedCard](https://docs-please.pages.dev/docs/components/linked-card): Card-style navigation links for related content

## Landing

- [PleaseAI Docs](https://docs-please.pages.dev): Ship fast, flexible, and SEO-optimized documentation with beautiful design out of the box. Built with shadcn-vue and Nuxt Content.
